data.exact_reserve_text: The claims development table on page 17 shows the cumulative gross claims incurred by underwriting year and development period.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The result for calendar year 2020 has been affected by the exceptional impact of COVID-19, primarily on contingency class where the Syndicate had exposure to events cancellation risks. This impact is inferred to also affect prior year reserves, contributing to the overall strengthening.

named_events.loss_description: exceptional impact of COVID-19, primarily on contingency class where the Syndicate had exposure to events cancellation risks.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced an overall strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 13.801 million, representing 7.27% of opening gross claims outstanding. This movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, showing adverse development for the 2016 and 2018 underwriting years, partially offset by a release for 2017. While not explicitly quantified for prior year development, the report notes the exceptional impact of COVID-19 on the 2020 calendar year result, particularly on contingency class, which is inferred to have contributed to the adverse development in prior year reserves. General factors such as economic inflation, social inflation, and litigation trends are also cited as key assumptions affecting liability estimates.
